query.text: declare @s nvarchar(4000) select nam, stt_rec, tk, ma_kh, ma_vv, ma_sp, ma_bp, ma_hd, ma_ku, ma_phi, so_lsx, ma_td1, ma_td2, ma_td3, s6, s4, s5 into #h from dmpb1n where nam = @y and stt_rec = @stt_rec select @s = 'update #h set s6 = b.he_so' + replace(replace(str(@p2, 2), ' ', '0'), '''', '') + ', s4 = b.hs9hs' + replace(replace(str(@p2, 2), ' ', '0'), '''', '') + ', s5 = b.hs9tien' + replace(replace(str(@p2, 2), ' ', '0'), '''', '') + ' from #h a join dmpb1n b on a.nam = b.nam and a.stt_rec = b.stt_rec and a.tk = b.tk and a.ma_kh = b.ma_kh and a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv and a.ma_sp = b.ma_sp and a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp and a.ma_hd = b.ma_hd and a.ma_ku = b.ma_ku and a.ma_phi = b.ma_phi and a.so_lsx = b.so_lsx and a.ma_td1 = b.ma_td1 and a.ma_td2 = b.ma_td2 and a.ma_td3 = b.ma_td3' if exists(select 1 from options where name = 'm_hs_pb_unit' and rtrim(val) = '1') set @s = @s + ' and ma_dvcs = ''' + replace(@u, '''', '''''') + '''' exec sp_executesql @s select @@fieldExternal into #r from @@prime$partition$current a left join dmtk b on a.tk = b.tk left join dmvv c on a.ma_vv = c.ma_vv left join dmhd d on a.ma_hd = d.ma_hd &ManagementObjectTranDetailQuery; where @@whereClause order by @@orderByClause select @s = 'update #r set s6 = b.s6, s4 = b.s4, s5 = b.s5 from #r a left join #h b on a.tk = b.tk and a.ma_vv = b.ma_vv and a.ma_bp = b.ma_bp and a.ma_hd = b.ma_hd' exec sp_executesql @s select * from #r order by @@orderByClause
